tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground in apps, report pages and templates. Plate behind every logo on a colour.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: App page background behind cards, zebra rows in tables, the findings box.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Report side band (fades from surface), empty track of a progress bar, table header fill in annexes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-soft and surface-band (15.9:1 on surface). Text and icons on yellow, cat-yellow and cat-olive.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, running feet, helper text and table labels on surface, surface-soft and surface-band (7.5:1, 6.9:1, 5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue, navy, crimson, purple, royal and cat-blue at any size. On blue-sky, cat-green, cat-ochre, cat-orange and cat-mauve only at display size (24px and up, or bold 19px and up).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only (1.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls on surface and surface-soft (3.1:1).

tokens.name: blue-sky
tokens.usage: CYP blue: the seal and the letters CYP in the app wordmarks. Icon discs, the diagonal panel on blue grounds, display text of 24px and up on surface (3.5:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the page row under the app bar and the chapter row, links, heading underlines, report running heads. Text on surface and surface-soft (6.6:1). Upper stop of the cover gradient.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The app bar of the three apps, lower stop of the cover gradient, chapter openers. Text on surface (14:1).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Subtitle on blue and navy (5.4:1 and 11.6:1), the date disc, the marker under the active item in the app bar. Never on surface and never on blue-sky.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Highlight colour of outcome 1. Use it through outcome-1. Text on surface (6.5:1). Not used in apps.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Highlight colour of outcome 2. Use it through outcome-2. Text on surface (9:1).

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: Third highlight colour, held for outcome-3. Text on surface (9:1).

tokens.name: cat-blue
tokens.usage: Palette colour 1, assigned to Luigi. Use it through place-luigi. Carries on-dark.

tokens.name: cat-yellow
tokens.usage: Palette colour 2, assigned to Minsundu. Use it through place-minsundu. Carries ink.

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: Palette colour 3, assigned to Nkwazi Centre. Use it through place-nkwazi. Carries on-dark at display size only.

tokens.name: cat-orange
tokens.usage: Palette colour 4, assigned to the Community school. Use it through place-community-school. Carries on-dark at display size only, ink at text size.

tokens.name: cat-mauve
tokens.usage: Palette colour 5, assigned to Holy Family. Use it through place-holy-family. Carries on-dark at display size only, ink at text size.

tokens.name: cat-olive
tokens.usage: Palette colour 6, assigned to Mary Christine. Use it through place-mary-christine. Carries ink.

tokens.name: cat-ochre
tokens.usage: Palette colour 7, assigned to Ukubalula. Use it through place-ukubalula. Carries on-dark at display size only.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status done, paid, synced: text and icon on ok-soft and on surface (5.7:1 and 6.6:1). Always with its word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an ok status tag or banner.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status waiting, moved, to revise, offline, something missing on a request, figures that are late: text and icon on warn-soft and on surface (6.6:1 and 7.3:1). Always with its word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a warn status tag or banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors (a wrong PIN, an empty required field), the statuses not approved, absent and over budget, figures that are short, and destructive buttons: text and icon on danger-soft and surface (6.3:1 and 7.5:1), or a fill carrying on-dark (7.5:1). Always with its word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a danger status tag or banner.

tokens.name: chitenge-green
tokens.usage: Chitenge pattern in the app wordmarks and the chitenge strip. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: chitenge-orange
tokens.usage: Chitenge pattern only.

tokens.name: chitenge-red
tokens.usage: Chitenge pattern only.

tokens.name: chitenge-black
tokens.usage: Chitenge pattern only.

tokens.name: place-luigi
tokens.usage: Luigi, in every chart, bar, swatch and opener of the apps, the narrative report and the templates. First in every list of places.

tokens.name: place-minsundu
tokens.usage: Minsundu, everywhere. Second in every list of places.

tokens.name: place-nkwazi
tokens.usage: Nkwazi Centre, everywhere. Third.

tokens.name: place-community-school
tokens.usage: Community school, everywhere. Fourth.

tokens.name: place-holy-family
tokens.usage: Holy Family, everywhere. Fifth.

tokens.name: place-mary-christine
tokens.usage: Mary Christine, everywhere. Sixth.

tokens.name: place-ukubalula
tokens.usage: Ukubalula, everywhere. Seventh.

tokens.name: place-other
tokens.usage: Other or all places together, when a chart needs a rest slice. Last. Carries ink.

tokens.name: outcome-1
tokens.usage: Outcome 1, rehabilitation and inclusion of vulnerable young people: its result bands and the frame of its progress tables in reports.

tokens.name: outcome-2
tokens.usage: Outcome 2, social enterprises and livelihoods: its result bands and the frame of its progress tables in reports.

tokens.name: outcome-3
tokens.usage: Held for a third outcome. Not used until the logframe has one.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on surface and surface-soft: 3px solid, 2px offset (14:1 and 12.8:1). On blue and navy the ring is yellow.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Report cover title, set in capitals on blue.

styles.name: chapter-number
styles.usage: Chapter number on a chapter opener, with a full stop.

styles.name: opener-title
styles.usage: Title of a chapter or section opener, in capitals.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one large number in a result block or stat tile.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section heading inside a report page, in capitals, with the blue underline.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Title of a chart, table, box or app screen. Sentence case.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card title, form group title, row title in apps and templates.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels in apps.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Category labels, running heads and feet, table column heads. Capitals.

styles.name: body-report
styles.usage: Body copy of the narrative report (9.5pt on 15pt in print). Not for apps.
styles.sample: The three centres recorded attendance every day of the term.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy in apps and internal templates. Smallest size for anything a person must read on a phone.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The phrase a reader scans for inside body copy. In reports the same weight at body-report size.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quoted words from a person or a document inside report copy. Italic, in ink.
styles.sample: We count the plates before we serve.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text under a field, meta lines in templates.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Status tags, banners, the sync state in the app bar, the title line of a note.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions and footnotes in reports and templates only. The lead (Figure 3:) is bold.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls, between a tag and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and screen padding on phones. Gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between blocks of a report page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of result blocks and boxes in reports.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a report page. Page margin of templates.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Inner margin of covers and openers.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every block in reports and templates: result blocks, bars, boxes, tables, photos.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, status tags and cards in apps.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Icon discs, the date disc, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card that floats over a photo or a map in reports, and sheets that open over a screen in apps. Nothing else has a shadow.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height and width of anything a person taps.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the app bar.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the TabBar at the bottom of a phone screen.

tokens.name: content-narrow
tokens.usage: Widest a form, a list or a block of text gets on a computer. Width of a Sheet shown as a card.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Widest a table, a register or a dashboard gets on a computer.

tokens.name: screen-computer
tokens.usage: Width from which a screen counts as a computer: the nav row replaces the TabBar and a Sheet becomes a card. Media queries cannot read a variable, so bundle.css repeats this value.

tokens.name: badge-size
tokens.usage: Height and smallest width of a count badge.

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Photo or initials of a child at the start of a list row.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Height of a button or a select inside a table row, on a computer used with a mouse. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: disc-sm
tokens.usage: Icon disc beside a list row or a category label.

tokens.name: disc-lg
tokens.usage: Icon disc of a result band and of a progress table.

tokens.name: rule-heading
tokens.usage: Thickness of the underline of heading-1 and of the active marker in the app bar.

tokens.name: page-a4
tokens.usage: Width of an A4 page at 96 dpi, for report pages and templates on screen.

fontShorthand.note: The type styles as variables, for a font declaration: font: var(--type-small) var(--font-text). They repeat the values of the type styles above.

tokens.name: type-chapter-number
tokens.usage: Type style chapter-number for the display family: font: var(--type-chapter-number) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-opener-title
tokens.usage: Type style opener-title for the display family: font: var(--type-opener-title) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-figure
tokens.usage: Type style figure for the display family: font: var(--type-figure) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-heading-1
tokens.usage: Type style heading-1 for the display family: font: var(--type-heading-1) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-heading-2
tokens.usage: Type style heading-2 for the display family: font: var(--type-heading-2) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-heading-3
tokens.usage: Type style heading-3 for the display family: font: var(--type-heading-3) var(--font-display).

tokens.name: type-button

tokens.name: type-label-caps

tokens.name: type-body-report
tokens.usage: Type style body-report for the text family: font: var(--type-body-report) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-body
tokens.usage: Type style body for the text family: font: var(--type-body) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-body-strong
tokens.usage: Type style body-strong for the text family: font: var(--type-body-strong) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-quote
tokens.usage: Type style quote for the text family: font: var(--type-quote) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-small
tokens.usage: Type style small for the text family: font: var(--type-small) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-small-strong
tokens.usage: Type style small-strong for the text family: font: var(--type-small-strong) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: type-caption
tokens.usage: Type style caption for the text family: font: var(--type-caption) var(--font-text).

tokens.name: track-caps
tokens.usage: Letter spacing of label-caps.

motion.note: Durations and easings. All movement is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-press
tokens.usage: A button reacting to the press.

tokens.name: motion-state
tokens.usage: A control changing state: a choice picked, a box ticked, a field in error.

tokens.name: motion-tab
tokens.usage: The marker moving to another item of the TabBar or the nav row.

tokens.name: motion-sheet
tokens.usage: A Sheet rising when it opens.

tokens.name: motion-page
tokens.usage: A page coming in when the person changes page.

tokens.name: motion-bars
tokens.usage: Bars growing, once, when their page comes in.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between one piece of a new page and the next.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Easing for what enters: pages, topics and sheets.

tokens.name: ease-grow
tokens.usage: Easing for bars growing.
